Cusain under a second "Office of the Senior Minister" card; the org chart has a Senior Minister and an Assistant Senior Minister, so he is likely the Assistant Senior Minister (unconfirmed; an MFBM post of 2024-10-02 calls him "former BARMM’s Assistant Senior Minister" on his appointment as MFBM Deputy Minister).
